baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَزَرَ under لَا after كَلَّا, resolved through the dominant و ز ر shelter branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The indefinite refuge names any mountain hold, fortification, or relied-on protection; the doubled refusal closes the entire class rather than identifying one unavailable place.

activation_trace.role: Refuge or shelter supplies the protective place whose whole category is negated.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that there is nowhere to go.
changed_reading.after: An emphatic foreclosure of every external protective hold: no place can be made into a refuge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same وَزَرَ is branch-linked to both a heavy burden and a supporting minister who carries another's weight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Burden and minister form a load-transfer mechanism: weight seeks a carrier, while a supporter relieves another by bearing it. The negation can therefore deny relief through transfer as well as deny shelter.

activation_trace.role: The heavy-load image supplies what must be borne rather than escaped spatially.
The supporting minister supplies the possible carrier whose relief is denied.

changed_reading.after: There is also no load-bearing helper to absorb or carry away what belongs to the person.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَزَرَ through و ز ر/B005, the branch of securing, taking away, or appropriating a thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A refuge can be construed as a secured reserve: something possessed, removed from danger, and held for later use. Total negation denies such an escape asset.

activation_trace.role: Securing or taking something supplies the image of an escape resource kept in hand.

changed_reading.before: No ready-made shelter exists outside the person.
changed_reading.after: Nothing has been secured, appropriated, or carried forward as a reserve for escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flight seeks an open branch in the route, refuge would provide an intermediate protected station, and settled stability is then located under the Lord's sovereignty. The focus denial closes the middle station without erasing the terminal destination.

activation_trace.role: Shelter supplies the would-be intermediate station that the focus ayah removes.
Flight and escape supply the outgoing motion that searches for a branch in the route.
Lordship and sovereignty make the endpoint governed rather than self-selected.
Fixity and settlement supply the terminal station that remains after refuge is denied.

structural_cues: The adjacent 75:10-12 sequence moves from the question أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ, through كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ, to the fronted destination إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ and ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flight, shelter, sovereign lordship, and fixed settlement; I supply the route arrow that treats shelter as a self-chosen intermediate stop. A live alternative is that 75:12 merely names the end without specifying route topology.

changed_reading.after: No lateral or intermediate refuge interrupts the compelled movement from attempted flight to the governed place of settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The account returns as delivered information, is internally known by the self, and remains in place even when excuses are cast outward. This sequence turns the burden/helper branches into a model of liability that cannot be delegated to a carrier or advocate.

activation_trace.role: The heavy burden supplies the accountable weight that remains with its bearer.
The minister who carries another's burden supplies the unavailable transfer mechanism.
A delivered report brings the person's prior and deferred acts back into the reckoning.
The thing itself or own self localizes the evidence and its liability in the person.
Inner sight supplies self-knowledge that prevents outsourcing the account.
Casting an object makes the excuses an outward defensive deployment.
The excuse names the attempted exculpation that fails to carry the burden away.

structural_cues: 75:13-15 progresses from being informed of one's acts, to the self as بصيرة, to the concessive failure of cast excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies returned information, self-insight, casting, excuse, burden, and burden-carrier; I infer that self-evidence makes the load nontransferable. The spatial-refuge reading remains independently live.

changed_reading.before: The burden and helper branches are only a focus-word possibility.
changed_reading.after: The burden is the person's own disclosed account, and neither advocate nor excuse can take its weight over.

context_deltas.mechanism: Excuses have a branch image of curtains and are grammatically cast; they can therefore be modeled as a screen erected against exposure. Inner sight leaves that screen transparent, so the denied refuge includes rhetorical cover.

activation_trace.role: Shelter supplies the protective function that an excuse-curtain attempts to imitate.
Inner sight supplies the exposure that sees through a defensive screen.
Throwing or casting supplies the action by which the screen is deployed.
The excuses-as-curtains image supplies the literal screen and makes it a failed forensic shelter.

structural_cues: The concessive وَلَوْ in 75:15 makes the casting of excuses ineffective after 75:14 has located sight in the self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shelter, inward sight, casting, and excuses-as-curtains; I supply the arrow from curtain to attempted forensic refuge. The live alternative is that معاذير denotes apologies with no spatial screen mechanism.

changed_reading.before: No physical shelter can conceal the person.
changed_reading.after: No explanatory curtain can be thrown up as shelter from self-disclosing evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A protective recitation or rescuer is sought at the bodily limit, but separation follows, bodily supports become entwined, and the person is driven toward the sovereign endpoint. Refuge is thus denied as an intervention capable of arresting the terminal sequence.

activation_trace.role: Refuge supplies the protection that a last intervention would need to provide.
The protective, breath-blown incantation supplies a concrete last-rescue technology.
Separation between two things supplies the irreversible transition the rescue fails to stop.
One thing wrapping around another supplies bodily closure and loss of free locomotion.
Sovereign lordship supplies the authority governing the terminal destination.
Driving or herding supplies compelled motion after bodily agency fails.

structural_cues: 75:26 supplies the branchless bodily threshold ت ر ق at the collarbones; 75:27-30 then runs from the call for a رَاقٍ to separation, entwining, and the drive to the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective incantation, separation, wrapping, sovereign destination, and driving; I infer that رَاقٍ is sought as a rescuer and that entwining blocks self-escape. The ascent branch of ر ق ي remains a material alternative.

changed_reading.before: There is no static place in which to hide.
changed_reading.after: No healer, protective rite, or recovered bodily mobility can arrest the passage into compelled conveyance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Scattered bones can be gathered, fine bodily form can be restored, and the creator's capacity extends from original formation to life after death. Material disassembly therefore cannot function as a hiding state beyond retrieval.

activation_trace.role: Refuge supplies the protective state that bodily dissolution might otherwise appear to offer.
Joining scattered parts into one supplies retrieval from bodily dispersal.
Hard bone supplies the durable but separable material to be retrieved.
Effective capacity supplies the agency able to restore even fine bodily form.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the constructive reversal of dissolution.
Living, spirit-bearing existence supplies the state restored to what had died.
Loss of force and life supplies the apparent terminal state that fails as concealment.

structural_cues: The early challenge in 75:3-4 about gathering bones and restoring fingertips is answered by the closing formation sequence in 75:37-40 and its question about giving life to the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersal, gathering, constructive power, life, and death; I supply the assumption that dissolution could be imagined as escape from later encounter. Alternatively, these verses establish resurrection without making death a sought refuge.

changed_reading.before: No external location shelters the living person.
changed_reading.after: Not even bodily dispersal or death shelters identity from reassembly and renewed encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sight freezes while the two major celestial markers are gathered into one scene; the distinctions by which flight could orient itself fail before the question about escape. The denied refuge becomes not only absent terrain but an absent coordinate system for finding terrain.

activation_trace.role: Mountain shelter and relied-on protection supply the destination that orientation would need to locate.
The fixed, startled eye supplies perceptual arrest at the start of attempted orientation.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the navigational faculty that is overwhelmed.
Joining formerly separate things removes a stable celestial distinction.
The sun supplies one major celestial marker in the collapsed pair.
The moon and its sky-light supply the second celestial marker in the collapsed pair.
Flight supplies the motion that now lacks reliable bearings or destination.

structural_cues: 75:7-11 accelerates from visual arrest, through altered moon and the gathering of sun and moon, to the human's escape question and the denial of refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sight, merged luminaries, flight, and shelter; I infer that celestial distinctions normally orient movement. A live alternative is that the cosmic signs intensify terror without contributing a navigation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: No refuge exists at a reachable place.
changed_reading.after: The perceptual and celestial bearings needed to identify a reachable refuge have themselves collapsed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attachment is invested in what arrives quickly while the later domain is abandoned. Against the focus branch of securing and taking something away, this preference structure leaves no deferred reserve available when escape is sought.

activation_trace.role: Securing or carrying something away supplies the reserve that should remain available later.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the binding preference that directs present investment.
Haste and advancement supply the attraction of the immediate return.
Leaving a thing supplies the abandonment that prevents it from becoming a reserve.
Laterness supplies the deferred horizon that has been left unsecured.

structural_cues: The second كَلَّا in 75:20 opens the paired contrast between loving ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ and leaving ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ, echoing the focus ayah's refusal formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies securing, heartfelt attachment, immediacy, abandonment, and laterness; I supply the reserve-allocation arrow. The alternative is a direct contrast of preferences with no asset or storage analogy.

changed_reading.before: No escape resource happens to be in hand.
changed_reading.after: No later reserve is in hand because attachment secured the immediate and abandoned the deferred horizon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ز و ر mapping rather than the dominant و ز ر refuge branch. It remains anchored to the exact focus occurrence and is activated by the adjacent flight and settlement sequence; downstream prose should label it a split-root resonance, not replace the ordinary noun reading with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence وَزَرَ mapped to root_000654/B001, turning aside and deviation.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside supplies a branch-distant image of a lateral detour being denied.
Flight supplies the attempt to leave the imposed line of movement.
Fixed settlement supplies the endpoint from which no detour succeeds.

changed_reading.before: There is no shelter along the escape route.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, there is no turning aside from the line between attempted flight and fixed settlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it carries the focus branch of securing or taking into the distant tongue-and-recitation sequence. It remains anchored in و ز ر/B005 and gains a functional mechanism from haste followed by divinely assigned gathering; render it only as an anti-grasping resonance, not as the local lexical translation of وَزَرَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَزَرَ through the dominant root's B005 branch of securing or taking something away.

activation_trace.role: Securing or taking supplies the attempted grasping of recited material.
Movement against stillness supplies the receiver's effort to capture the utterance physically.
The tongue as speech organ supplies the instrument used in that attempted capture.
Haste supplies the pressure to seize the material before it seems to pass.
Gathering dispersed material supplies the securing function assigned to another agent.
Reading and recitation supply the material whose retention is at issue.

changed_reading.before: No thing can be secured as an escape reserve.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, security does not come from hurriedly grasping utterance; its gathering and recitation are received rather than seized.

strongest_changes: The immediate flight-refuge-settlement sequence turns a static lack of shelter into closure of every self-chosen intermediate station.
The burden and minister branches, activated by report, self-insight, and failed excuses, make the person's account nontransferable.
The deathbed and reassembly sequences extend refuge denial from place to failed intervention and then to bodily dissolution itself.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package activated spatial route closure, load-bearing responsibility, and failed protective screens inside one focus noun, while allowing temporal-reserve, cosmic-orientation, speech-capture, and split-root resonances to remain distinct and contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The burden/helper model may be productive branch association rather than the noun form's immediate sense.
The terminal no-rescue model partly depends on activating رَاقٍ through protective incantation rather than ascent.
The non-dominant ز و ر mapping may support an audible detour resonance or may remain only packet-level form distance.
The cosmic-coordinate, deferred-reserve, and revelation-capture mechanisms depend on explicit reader-supplied arrows and should remain exploratory.
